newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - BZW upgrades Mirror to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BZW upgrades Mirror to hold.

text.p: Mirror Group Newspapers Plc was upgraded from a "sell" to a "hold" by broker BZW.
In an note, the broker said the upgrade was prompted by a 10 percent discount of Mirror shares to the market.
The discount, calculated after BZW revised earnings forecasts for Mirror, was big enough to raise the recommendation, BZW said.
It added it saw five to 10 percent upside in Mirror shares, which were down one penny at 208-1/2 in late morning trade.
BZW raised its 1998 pre-tax profit forecast to 101.9 million stg from 105.5 million after Mirror yesterday reported a 6.6 percent increase in 1996 profits to 82.2 million stg.
